VITAL separates geometric alignment from preservation of discrete photoacoustic amplitudes by coupling interpretable keypoint-based global registration with topology-preserving dense refinement and nearest-neighbor resampling.

summary_en: Develops diffraction-grating-coupled-mode Fabry-Pérot resonators for optical detection of ultrasound and photoacoustic signals.
